title: Allyson Whitmell’s “Crack in my Window” is a beautiful farewell wrapped in strings
htmlContent: Allyson Whitmell's new single, "Crack in My Window," beautifully captures feelings of nostalgia, loss, and appreciation for what we once had. The song centers around the idea that even a small, broken window can hold significant memories of a home we loved. Whitmell skillfully turns this universal feeling into a moving piece of music, combining her lovely piano playing with a heartfelt string section featuring Jono Hill, known for his work on "Bridgerton." The finished song is warm, gentle, and filled with a sense of longing. Ben Pelchat's production helps take "Crack in My Window" to a whole new level, adding layers that create a dreamy atmosphere. The music feels light and immaterial, blending the past with the present and capturing the struggle between holding on to memories and learning to let go. https://open.spotify.com/album/7lNXzGxooWZNRYKxSusY3q?si=Ocio6T6bQDq_sShyQz-qsQ Whitmell invites us to share in a moment where time feels different. A simple crack in the glass becomes a window to memories we can't relive, yet they remain unforgettable. Touching, engaging, and deeply beautiful, "Crack in My Window" is a remarkable example of how storytelling can shine through music, leaving a lasting impression. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram/TikTok
